plain_english: Bearing thirty-six principles, full-eyed in body-making: own or other's body, jar and the like — his god-house.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭtriṃśattattvabhṛtaṃ vigraharacanāgavākṣaparipūrṇam | nijam anyad atha śarīraṃ ghaṭādi vā tasya devagṛham

plain_english: There the supreme-self-great-Bhairava-Śiva-goddess, yoked to own power, sits worshipped with self-grasped pure gifts.
sanskrit_cite: tatra ca paramātmamahābhairavaśivadevatāṃ svaśaktiyutām | ātmāmarśanavimaladravyaiḥ paripūjayann āste

plain_english: Offering the great seed-heap of outer-inner-fancied difference in his blazing knowing-fire — effortless the offering.
sanskrit_cite: bahirantaraparikalpanabhedamahābījanicayam arpayataḥ | tasyātidīptasaṃvijjvalane yatnād vinā bhavati homaḥ

plain_english: Meditation never setting: the blessed Lord creates varied forms — that itself is meditation, true-formed as fancy draws.
sanskrit_cite: dhyānam anastamitaṃ punar eṣa hi bhagavān vicitrarūpāṇi | sṛjati tad eva dhyānaṃ saṃkalpālikhitasatyarūpatvam

plain_english: Turning world-rows, principle-order-fancies, sense-hosts in inner knowing — that, they say, is his muttering.
sanskrit_cite: bhuvanāvalīṃ samastāṃ tattvakramakalpanām athākṣagaṇam | antarbodhe parivartayati ca yat so 'sya japa uditaḥ

plain_english: Seeing all with an even glance, deeming knowing content, delighting in the world-burning-ground, grasping the body as skull-staff.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ samayā dṛṣṭyā yat paśyati yac ca saṃvidaṃ manute | viśvaśmaśānaniratāṃ vigrahakhaṭvāṅgakalpanākalitām

plain_english: Tasting the world-essence-drink-filled, own-hand-held, known-fragment bowl — this vow, hard to get and easy to get.
sanskrit_cite: viśvarasāsavapūrṇaṃ nijakaragaṃ vedyakha.ṅdakakapālam | rasayati ca yat tad etad vratam asya sudurlabhaṃ ca sulabhaṃ ca

plain_english: Thus birth-death-free, named truth-great-Lord, having got — by the finder's shining, done-done, standing as wished.
sanskrit_cite: iti janmanāśahīnaṃ paramārthamaheśvarākhyam upalabhya | upalabdhṛtāprakāśāt kṛtakṛtyas tiṣṭhati yatheṣṭam

plain_english: Pervading, so told, all-self, diversity-shaken, peerless bliss supreme: who knows becomes made of that.
sanskrit_cite: vyāpinam abhihitam itthaṃ sarvātmānaṃ vidhūtanānātvam | nirupamaparamānandaṃ yo vetti sa tanmayo bhavati
